sources.title: Generative AI - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is a subfield of artificial intelligence (AI) that uses generative models to generate text, images, videos, audio, software code or other forms of data. [1] These models learn the underlying patterns and structures of their training data, and use them to generate new data [2] in response to input, which often takes the form of natural language prompts ...

sources.title: Generative AI and the Foundation Model Era: A Comprehensive Review - MDPI
sources.snippet: These models form the core of many current generative AI (GenAI) systems and differ in important ways from traditional models built for a single task. Foundation models are not built for a single task; they aim to generalize across many tasks and data types, which allows zero-shot and few-shot learning in different domains and modalities [4].
